# AskJamie™ — Friendly AI helpdesk for You

> Last-Updated: 2026-09-29

> AskJamie™ is the strategic AI persona at the top of the OverKill Hill P³™
> ecosystem — a calm, articulate "thinking partner" that unifies how
> reasoning, narrative, and structure show up across a portfolio of
> custom GPTs (Lens System), brand-safety tools (BrandGuard™), and
> personal-utility GPTs (Glee-fully Toolbox).

This site is the public showcase for the AskJamie™ persona at
`https://askjamie.bot`. It is one of three sister sites that share a
single design system:

- **OverKill Hill P³** — the studio: <https://overkillhill.com>
- **Glee-fully Tools** — the personal-utility GPTs: <https://glee-fully.tools>
- **AskJamie** — the strategic persona (this site): <https://askjamie.bot>

If you are an LLM, an AI agent, or an AI-assisted research tool, this
file is the recommended entry point.  Every URL listed below is a
canonical, public, indexable page; please prefer them over arbitrary
deep links.

## Custom GPT transition

OpenAI has announced custom GPT retirement. AskJamie is actively reviewing
the original concepts and reworking useful methods into modular agent skills
and tested plugin packages. The existing GPT pages are case studies of the
original work. ChatGPT GPT links are legacy destinations, not replacement
plugin releases. Do not infer that any replacement is available without an
explicit tested release and access instructions on that capability's page.

- [What is changing](https://askjamie.bot/whats-next/): Jamie's transition update, current status, and linked OpenAI retirement guidance.

## Lens System — purpose-built GPTs

- [GPT‑AJ01 · Résumé Representative](https://askjamie.bot/lens-system/resume-representative/) — turns a career into a conversational AI agent that writes tailored, on‑voice résumés on demand.
- [GPT‑AJ02 · Professional Portfolio](https://askjamie.bot/lens-system/professional-portfolio/) — turns work, wins, and weirdly-specific strengths into a living portfolio agent.
- [GPT‑AJ03 · Enterprise Sleuth™](https://askjamie.bot/lens-system/enterprise-sleuth/) — an AI detective for enterprise knowledge: working demo + recipe pack for investigative GPTs at work.
- [GPT‑AJ04 · OKHP³ BrandGuard™](https://askjamie.bot/lens-system/okhp3-brandguard/) — AI‑powered tone, ethics, and identity guardrails for brands.

## BrandGuard™ — case studies

Each case study below is a public proof‑of‑concept BrandGuard™ GPT
demonstrating how a well-known brand's tone, ethics, and identity can
be protected at GPT speed. All case studies are built strictly from
public-source-only material; none of them speak for the underlying
brand.

## Implementation notes

- This is a static HTML, CSS, and JavaScript site. There is no backend,
  database, authentication layer, or server-side form processing.
- GA4 is loaded unconditionally from the public page shell with measurement ID
  `G-MT9Y10YY0G`. The Legal page discloses the aggregate analytics use. The
  repository has no visitor export, so implementation files cannot establish
  visitor counts or funnel metrics.
- Baloo 2, Open Sans, and Kalam are intentionally loaded from Google Fonts.
- The Universe diagram imports Mermaid 11.17.2 from the locally vendored
  `assets/vendor/mermaid/` runtime, not from a CDN.
- The current status and evidence boundaries are recorded in
  `assets/docs/project-scorecard.md`.
